pictures.scene: Repin, Religious Procession in Kursk Province — a vast dusty procession crossing open ground under a pale sky, gold icon-banners and a jewelled icon carried in the press behind, peasants, officials and a priest in gold vestments crowded together, a hunchbacked boy in grey straining forward on his crutch at the front, when jesus came down from the mountain, large crowds followed him, suddenly a leper came and knelt before him, saying, lord, if you are willing, you can make me clean
pictures.name: pd_repin_religious_procession_in_kursk_province

pictures.scene: El Greco, Christ Healing the Blind — a knot of bearded men and a woman in pink and gold gathered on the steps of a classical building, one old man in blue stretching his arm out toward them, a pale city square and a cart standing behind, clouds piled high over the roofs, jesus reached out his hand and touched the man, i am willing, he said, be clean, and immediately his leprosy was cleansed, then jesus instructed him, see that you don't tell anyone, but go, show yourself to the priest and offer the gift prescribed by moses, as a testimony to them
pictures.name: pd_el_greco_christ_healing_the_blind

pictures.scene: Veronese, Christ and the Centurion — Christ in a rose robe and blue mantle with his apostles pressing close behind him, a grey-bearded centurion in steel armour and a red cloak kneeling before him with his hand on his breast, a helmeted soldier holding him up by the arm and a halberd raised against the sky, when jesus had entered capernaum, a centurion came and pleaded with him, lord, my servant lies at home, paralyzed and in terrible agony
pictures.name: pd_veronese_centurion

pictures.scene: van Delen, The Pharisee and the Publican — a vast pale vaulted church interior with a chequered marble floor, a man in a dark red cloak standing praying at a pillar on the left, and far off at the right a barefoot man in a red robe standing alone with his head bowed and his hands on his breast, i will go and heal him, jesus replied, the centurion answered, lord, i am not worthy to have you come under my roof, but just say the word, and my servant will be healed
pictures.name: pd_delen_pharisee_and_publican

pictures.scene: Uccello, The Battle of San Romano — a white charger rearing in the middle of a troop of armoured knights, lances and broken staves crossing the field in long lines, more soldiers small among the ploughed hills behind, hounds and hares running across the slope, for i myself am a man under authority, with soldiers under me, i tell one to go, and he goes, and another to come, and he comes, i tell my servant to do something, and he does it, when jesus heard this, he marveled and said to those following him, truly i tell you, i have not found anyone in israel with such great faith
pictures.name: pd_uccello_the_battle_of_san_romano

pictures.scene: Bruegel, The Peasant Wedding — a barn hung with a green cloth and a paper crown, the bride sitting still beneath it with her hands folded and her eyes lowered, guests crowded shoulder to shoulder along a plank table eating from bowls, two servers carrying bowls of custard in on an unhinged door, i say to you that many will come from the east and the west to share the banquet with abraham, isaac, and jacob in the kingdom of heaven, but the sons of the kingdom will be thrown into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth
pictures.name: pd_bruegel_the_peasant_wedding

pictures.scene: Steen, The Sick Woman — a woman in a grey silk gown and a red bodice slumped sideways in her chair with one hand pressed to her stomach and a white veil over her hair, an old woman in a white cap leaning in from the right holding a glass instrument up to the light, then jesus said to the centurion, go, as you have believed, so will it be done for you, and his servant was healed at that very hour, when jesus arrived at peter's house, he saw peter's mother-in-law sick in bed with a fever
pictures.name: pd_steen_sick_woman

pictures.scene: Vermeer, Christ in the House of Martha and Mary — Christ in a purple robe and blue mantle seated at a white-clothed table with his hand raised in speech, martha in a yellow bodice and a white headcloth setting down a wicker basket of bread before him, mary seated low beside the table in red with her chin resting on her hand, so he touched her hand, and the fever left her, and she got up and began to serve them, when evening came, many who were demon-possessed were brought to jesus, and he drove out the spirits with a word and healed all the sick
pictures.name: pd_vermeer_christ_in_the_house_of_martha_and_mary

pictures.scene: Michelangelo, The Prophet Isaiah — the prophet in a rose robe and a green mantle seated on a marble seat, one hand keeping his place in a closed book on his knee, his head turned sharply back over his shoulder as though called by name, a curly-haired child at his side pointing away behind him, this was to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet isaiah, he took on our infirmities and carried our diseases, when jesus saw a large crowd around him, he gave orders to cross to the other side of the sea
pictures.name: pd_michelangelo_isaiah

pictures.scene: Friedrich, Wanderer above the Sea of Fog — a man in a dark green coat standing alone on a rock crag with his back to us, leaning on a stick, a white sea of fog filling the whole valley below him with bare rock spurs and faint blue ranges rising out of it, and one of the scribes came to him and said, teacher, i will follow you wherever you go, jesus replied, foxes have dens and birds of the air have nests, but the son of man has no place to lay his head
pictures.name: pd_friedrich_wanderer_above_the_sea_of_fog

pictures.scene: Courbet, A Burial at Ornans — a country burial under a grey sky, a tall black crucifix raised above the heads of the crowd, choirboys in white with a red cap and a brass holy-water pot, beadles in red robes, a priest reading from his book and mourners in black standing shoulder to shoulder along the hillside, another of his disciples requested, lord, first let me go and bury my father, but jesus told him, follow me, and let the dead bury their own dead
pictures.name: pd_courbet_a_burial_at_ornans

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, The Storm on the Sea of Galilee — a boat driven up onto a white breaking wave with its foresail torn and bellied out, one man hauling on a rope against the lit sky, disciples clinging to the mast and one leaning far over the side, Christ seated quietly in the stern at the back of the boat, when he got into the boat, his disciples followed him, suddenly a violent storm came up on the sea, so that the boat was engulfed by the waves, but jesus was sleeping
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_christ_in_the_storm_on_the_sea_of_galilee

pictures.scene: Bakhuizen, Christ in the Storm on the Sea of Galilee — one small boat lifted high on a white wave in a near-black squall, its sail gone slack and its ropes flying loose, the disciples crowded into the stern around Christ with one of them reaching out to him, gulls blown across the dark water, the disciples went and woke him, saying, lord, save us, we are perishing, you of little faith, jesus replied, why are you so afraid, then he got up and rebuked the winds and the sea, and it was perfectly calm
pictures.name: pd_bakhuizen_christ_in_the_storm_on_the_sea_of_galilee

pictures.scene: Ruisdael, The Jewish Cemetery — a ruined church tower of yellow stone standing roofless under a storm sky just breaking, heavy white marble tombs on the slope below it, a great dead tree fallen across the foreground and a stream running fast over stones, a faint rainbow showing at the left, the men were amazed and asked, what kind of man is this, even the winds and the sea obey him, when jesus arrived on the other side in the region of the gadarenes, he was met by two demon-possessed men coming from the tombs, they were so violent that no one could pass that way
pictures.name: pd_ruisdael_the_jewish_cemetery

pictures.scene: Berchem, Herdsmen with Cattle — a herd moving along a track in the warm haze of evening, a horned ox turning aside out of the line, a herdsman in a broad hat riding a donkey loaded with a pale fleece, a boy in a dark coat and white hose walking ahead with a basket and a staff, sheep and cattle crowding the path below a hill town, what do you want with us, son of god, they shouted, have you come here to torture us before the appointed time, in the distance a large herd of pigs was feeding
pictures.name: pd_berchem_herders_met_vee

pictures.scene: Snyders, The Boar Hunt — a dark bristling boar brought to bay under a heavy grey sky with its jaws open and its tusks showing, a white hound sprawled across its back and others seizing it at the throat and the ear, one dog thrown down flat on the sand beneath them, so the demons begged jesus, if you drive us out, send us into the herd of pigs, go, he told them, so they came out and went into the pigs, and the whole herd rushed down the steep bank into the sea and died in the waters
pictures.name: pd_snyders_the_boar_hunt

pictures.scene: Droochsloot, A Village Street — a wide sandy village street running back to a stone church tower, thatched and tiled houses crowded along both sides, townsfolk in brown and red coming out onto the open ground in twos and threes, women in white caps standing talking at the left and a man with his dog walking out toward the fields, those tending the pigs ran off into the town and reported all this, including the account of the demon-possessed men, then the whole town went out to meet jesus, and when they saw him, they begged him to leave their region
pictures.name: pd_droochsloot_dorp

lines.text: When Jesus came down from the mountain, large crowds followed Him.
Suddenly a leper came and knelt before Him, saying, Lord, if You are willing, You can make me clean.
Jesus reached out His hand and touched the man. I am willing, He said. Be clean! And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.
Then Jesus instructed him, See that you don't tell anyone. But go, show yourself to the priest and offer the gift prescribed by Moses, as a testimony to them.
When Jesus had entered Capernaum, a centurion came and pleaded with Him,
Lord, my servant lies at home, paralyzed and in terrible agony.
I will go and heal him, Jesus replied.
The centurion answered, Lord, I am not worthy to have You come under my roof. But just say the word, and my servant will be healed.
For I myself am a man under authority, with soldiers under me. I tell one to go, and he goes; and another to come, and he comes. I tell my servant to do something, and he does it.
When Jesus heard this, He marveled and said to those following Him, Truly I tell you, I have not found anyone in Israel with such great faith.
I say to you that many will come from the east and the west to share the banquet with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the kingdom of heaven.
But the sons of the kingdom will be thrown into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
Then Jesus said to the centurion, Go! As you have believed, so will it be done for you. And his servant was healed at that very hour.
When Jesus arrived at Peter's house, He saw Peter's mother-in-law sick in bed with a fever.
So He touched her hand, and the fever left her, and she got up and began to serve them.
When evening came, many who were demon-possessed were brought to Jesus, and He drove out the spirits with a word and healed all the sick.
This was to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah: He took on our infirmities and carried our diseases.
When Jesus saw a large crowd around Him, He gave orders to cross to the other side of the sea.
And one of the scribes came to Him and said, Teacher, I will follow You wherever You go.
Jesus replied, Foxes have dens and birds of the air have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay His head.
Another of His disciples requested, Lord, first let me go and bury my father.
But Jesus told him, Follow Me, and let the dead bury their own dead.
When He got into the boat, His disciples followed Him.
Suddenly a violent storm came up on the sea, so that the boat was engulfed by the waves; but Jesus was sleeping.
The disciples went and woke Him, saying, Lord, save us! We are perishing!
You of little faith, Jesus replied, why are you so afraid? Then He got up and rebuked the winds and the sea, and it was perfectly calm.
The men were amazed and asked, What kind of man is this? Even the winds and the sea obey Him!
When Jesus arrived on the other side in the region of the Gadarenes, He was met by two demon-possessed men coming from the tombs. They were so violent that no one could pass that way.
What do You want with us, Son of God? they shouted. Have You come here to torture us before the appointed time?
In the distance a large herd of pigs was feeding.
So the demons begged Jesus, If You drive us out, send us into the herd of pigs.
Go! He told them. So they came out and went into the pigs, and the whole herd rushed down the steep bank into the sea and died in the waters.
Those tending the pigs ran off into the town and reported all this, including the account of the demon-possessed men.
Then the whole town went out to meet Jesus. And when they saw Him, they begged Him to leave their region.
